Kat Caretaking Costs

Kat can upgrade all rarities of this pet.

  • Costs listed are at [Lv1]. For each level the pet has, there is a 0.3% discount.
  • The time listed is in real life days, not in-game time. It can be reduced by up to 10% using the Kat's Favorite attribute.

Tips

[edit | edit source]
  • The Quick Hands perk does not apply on  Gemstone Gauntlet's Reduced to Atoms and Kinetic abilities.
  • The Quick Hands perk does not apply on  Lesser Orb of Healing [Confirm].
  • The Insightful perk does not apply on Maniac Miner.
  • Not consuming  Mana due to the Insightful perk does not trigger Refrigerate.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • If a player is morphed into a  Rat Pet and moves near a player with a Crow Pet equipped, the  Rat Pet is despawned and the following message is sent in chat: [1]
OOPS! Your Crow ate <player>'s Rat!
